issues: 编辑器是灰色骨架条 + 2px 实色灰边，看不出这是个设计工具，蒸发前没有任何"复杂性"可以被减掉
Publish 是灰白小胶囊 + Helvetica，按钮起点 top=30 压在 60px 工具条的下沿上，没对齐
蒸发层只有 fade + 位移，读作"调透明度"；黑场是平的 #111110
字标是大写占位 WORDMARK；130f 里字标 spring 落定后只剩约 15f 就结束，品牌没 hold 住
光标直线滑向按钮，点击时没有按压反馈
changes: 编辑器重做为出版级假 UI：深色图层栏（11 个真实图层名、选中态）、属性面板真实字段（X/Y/W/H/Gap/Fill/Shadow）、点阵画布、带交通灯与地址栏的浏览器预览框里放升级后的 fixture 卡片，全部发丝线 + 双层软阴影
Publish 改为强调色靛蓝渐变按钮（内高光 + 同色外发光），按中心定位垂直居中在工具条里；迁移最快段按每帧位移加最多 3px 拖影，黑场上背后一盘同色柔光随压黑增强
每个蒸发层加 0→7px 渐增模糊，ease-in 加速离场的错峰顺序与位移量保持原值；黑场换带冷色相的 #0b0c10 + 中心微光 + 随压黑加深的暗角与颗粒
字标换成图形标 + Acme 的 lockup，spring 定版同时 9px→0 对焦，字标晚 3f 跟随；时长 130→144f，字标落定后 hold 满 1s（R1，md 同步）
光标 x/y 用不同缓动走手腕弧线，点击前后 4f 笔尖压下 0.88
issuesEn: The editor was grey skeleton bars with 2px solid grey borders, not recognisable as a design tool, so there was no complexity to strip away
Publish was a small grey-white pill in Helvetica, starting at top=30 so it sat on the bottom edge of the 60px toolbar
Layers only faded and shifted, reading as an opacity tweak; the black field was flat #111110
The wordmark was the placeholder WORDMARK, and in 130f only about 15f remained after its spring settled, so the brand never held
The cursor slid in a straight line and the click had no press feedback
changesEn: The editor is now a publication-grade mock: dark layers panel (11 real layer names, selected state), properties panel with real fields (X/Y/W/H/Gap/Fill/Shadow), dotted canvas, and a browser preview with traffic lights and address bar holding the upgraded fixture cards, all hairlines and two-layer soft shadows

Publish is an indigo gradient button (inner highlight, same-hue glow) centred vertically in the toolbar; the fastest part of its migration gets up to 3px of speed blur, and on black a soft same-colour halo grows with the darkening

Each evaporating layer gains a 0→7px rising blur while the staggered ease-in order and offsets stay as specified; the black field is cool-tinted #0b0c10 with a faint centre glow plus vignette and grain that deepen with the fade
The wordmark is a mark + Acme lockup: spring settle with a 9px→0 focus pull, wordmark trailing 3f; duration 130→144f so the settled lockup holds a full second (R1, md updated)
The cursor follows a wrist arc via separate x/y easing and dips to 0.88 for 4f around the click
